question: What will be the percentage change in Apple (AAPL) stock (AAPL on Yahoo Finance) from the close on 2026-08-14 to the close on 2026-08-25?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to 100 x (close on 2026-08-25 / close on 2026-08-14 - 1), using daily closes of AAPL on Yahoo Finance. If there is no close on 2026-08-25, the last close before it is used.

research:
I couldn't get the AAPL close for Aug 14, 2026 from Yahoo Finance itself. Every page fetch (Yahoo, StockAnalysis, Investing.com, TwelveData) was refused by the proxy, so the figures below come from search-result snippets. Some search results included data from after Aug 15; I left all of it out.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question settles on AAPL daily closes on Yahoo Finance: 100 x (close on Aug 25 / close on Aug 14 - 1). The Yahoo history page wouldn't load. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/AAPL/history/)
- 2026-08-14: StatMuse lists open $306.00, high $307.49, low $304.30, close **$305.93**, volume about 28.2M. Only one source gives this, and I couldn't check it against Yahoo. [StatMuse](https://www.statmuse.com/money/ask/apple-stock-prices-2026)
- 2026-08-15: a forecast-site snippet says "$305.89 as of 15.08.2026", which roughly matches. [Tradersunion](https://tradersunion.com/currencies/forecast/apple/)
- 2026-08-12: close $302.25 (open $305.10, high $305.66, low $300.57). Aug 11 close: $305.07. [StatMuse](https://www.statmuse.com/money/ask/apple-stock-prices-2026), [Stonksmaster](https://www.stonksmaster.com/2026/08/apple-aapl-expected-price-range-for_0574537817.html)
- 2026-08-10: ex-dividend date for the $0.27 quarterly dividend, so no dividend falls inside the window. [Google Finance](https://www.google.com/finance/quote/AAPL:NASDAQ)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has happened yet that settles the question. The window covers 7 trading days: Aug 17-21 and Aug 24-25. The starting price is about $305.9.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- Mid-August 2026: several low-quality, templated pages say the stock fell about 5% over the past 30 days on AI worries. They are not reliable. [example](https://old.media-azi.md/apple-stock-gcc8.html)
- 2026-08-03: 24/7 Wall St. put AAPL at $308.91, rated it a Hold, and said it fell 9.15% after an earnings beat. It expects an August "news vacuum" before the September iPhone event. [24/7 Wall St.](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/08/03/apples-predictable-august-news-vacuum-tells-you-exactly-what-to-expect-this-month/)
- 2026-07-31 onward: Apple reportedly lost more than $400B in market value over two sessions and gave up the title of world's most valuable company. [INDmoney](https://www.indmoney.com/blog/us-stocks/apple-q3-earnings-results-why-aapl-stock-drop-analysis)
- 2026-07-30: fiscal Q3 results:
  - Revenue $109.42B (+16% year over year) against about $108.65B expected; EPS $2.02 against about $1.89.
  - September-quarter guidance of +9-11% implies about $113B, below the roughly $114.9B consensus. Apple blamed shortages of chip capacity and memory.
  - Services ($30.74B) and Greater China ($18.8B) both missed.
  - Shares fell 4-8% after hours.
  [FXLeaders](https://www.fxleaders.com/news/2026/07/30/apple-q3-revenue-sends-aapl-stock-toward-300-as-weak-outlook-and-china-sales-trigger-selloff/), [Tiger](https://www.itiger.com/news/1124975587)
- 2026-07-29: reported all-time high of $343.52. [Tradersunion](https://tradersunion.com/currencies/forecast/apple/)

## 4. Base rates
- Apple's daily moves have usually been about 1.3-1.8% (standard deviation). Over 7 trading days that works out to about ±3.5-4.5%. This is my own rough calculation, not from a source.
- Recent trend: down about 11% from the Jul 29 high ($343.52) to about $306. Since early August the stock has moved sideways in roughly a $300-310 range: $308.91 on Aug 3, $305.07 on Aug 11, $302.25 on Aug 12, $305.93 on Aug 14.
- Late August with no earnings has historically been a quiet stretch for Apple, which suggests lower volatility than usual (24/7 Wall St., Aug 3).
- 2026-08 (date unclear): 39 analysts have an average 12-month price target of $330.53. [MarketBeat](https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/AAPL/forecast/)

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found a page for a market called "AAPL close above 310 on August 24, 2026", but couldn't open it to see prices. [struct.to](https://explorer.struct.to/markets/aapl-close-above-310-on-august-24-2026)
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold prices for this window.
- Algorithmic forecasts are noisy and conflict with each other. Tradersunion's August range ($278-290) sits far below the actual price. [30rates](https://30rates.com/apple)

## 6. Upcoming events before Aug 25
- 2026-08-17 to 08-25: no Apple-specific scheduled catalysts. The iPhone 18 / foldable event is expected Sept 9, after the window, but rumors and previews could leak beforehand. [Pluang](https://pluang.com/en/news-feed/kinerja-apple-aapl-target-harga-dan-kepercayaan-investor)
- Macro events in the window: the FOMC minutes are typically released about three weeks after the July meeting, which puts them around Aug 19 (I didn't confirm the date). Retailer earnings also land that week.
- Jackson Hole runs Aug 27-29, with Fed Chair Warsh's keynote on Aug 28. That is after the window, though traders may position ahead of it. [Regards of Wall Street](https://www.regardsofwallstreet.com/news/jackson-hole-2026-dates-schedule-warsh-first-speech)
- Nvidia earnings usually come in late August, so they could fall after the window; I didn't confirm the date.
- Risks to watch: memory and chip supply, China tariff news, and AI-strategy headlines.
